messages:
nina: Noticing customers hit duplicate side-effects from the onboarding RPC sample when token refresh + 429 coincide. repro'd locally.
leo: can you share the minimal repro steps and the snippet from the sample that does retries?
nina: steps: start sample with short-lived token, flood /v1/chat requests, force token refresh mid-flight, some requests get 429 and SDK retries after refresh. sample doesn't add an idempotency header so server treats retry as new.
ash: how does our SDK decide to replay on 429? is it blind replay of the same body?
nina: yes, current client retry simply replays body after auth refresh. no correlation headers.
leo: two-prong fix in sample: (1) add Idempotency-Key per logical operation and persist it across retries, (2) optionally emit replay headers on retry attempts so legacy servers can dedupe.
ash: recommend headers: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` always on user-visible operations, `X-RW-Replay-Id: <uuid>` + `X-RW-Replay: 1` only on retries. SDK can auto-generate replay-id and reuse idempotency key.
qa-bot: test suggestion: integration test that simulates token expiry mid-flight and asserts server processed webhook only once.
leo: also SDK config: expose `safeReplayWindowMs` default 3000ms. If retry happens after that window for non-idempotent ops, SDK should surface an error instead of replaying. document tradeoffs.
nina: will prototype sample changes and tests. I'll also add a short note in the README: "To avoid duplicates on 429+auth events, use idempotency keys or enable replay headers for server-side dedupe."
ash: add telemetry event `sdk.replay_attempt` with replay_id and non-PII reason so ops can correlate spikes.
leo: sounds good. open an issue and link PR for review once ready.
qa-bot: created issue #3511 for onboarding sample idempotency + replay headers.
